head: codex/5791-wp18-final-review-second-pass
title: [v0.91.8][WP-18] Complete internal review second pass
body:
## Summary

- completes the #5791 WP-18 second-pass internal review packet for v0.91.8 changes since the prior WP-18 review
- fixes active docs/helpers/tests that still referenced deleted C-SDLC closeout commands
- repairs the PR #5799 cargo validation wrapper failure by allowing `cargo fmt` through the lockfile-drift guard while keeping `--locked` required for other Cargo commands
- fixes assigned-review publication phase advancement so typed review evidence can advance from implemented to reviewed
- bumps active Rust package metadata from 0.91.7 to 0.91.8 for the v0.91.8 review tail
- repairs stale WP-17-active release-tail truth in non-colliding current docs; `REVIEW.md` remains routed to #5357 because typed claim ownership blocks #5791 from editing it

## Validation

- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate_terminal_authority_deletion`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate4 routine_lifecycle_contract_measures_four_commands_and_two_artifacts`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-builds/5791/csdlc-v2 cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate5`
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-builds/5791/csdlc-v2 cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all -- --check`
- `bash adl/tools/test_run_cargo_validation.sh`
- `cargo metadata --locked --manifest-path adl/Cargo.toml --no-deps --format-version 1`
- `cargo metadata --locked --manifest-path adl-runtime/Cargo.toml --no-deps --format-version 1`
- `cargo metadata --locked --manifest-path tools/aws_remote_validation/Cargo.toml --no-deps --format-version 1`
- `git diff --check`
- `rg '^version = "0\\.91\\.7"|Compiling adl v0\\.91\\.7' adl/Cargo.toml adl/Cargo.lock adl-runtime/Cargo.toml adl-runtime/Cargo.lock tools/aws_remote_validation/Cargo.toml tools/aws_remote_validation/Cargo.lock` exits 1 as expected
- `rg 'WP-17 (is now|is active|documentation truth alignment is active)|Current ADL and Runtime v2 crate version: 0\\.91\\.7' README.md docs/milestones/v0.91.8/CANONICAL_DOC_INVENTORY_v0.91.8.md docs/milestones/v0.91.8/NEXT_MILESTONE_HANDOFF_v0.91.8.md` exits 1 as expected

Closes #5791
